text:
marta: Quick brain-dump: proposal for a tiny universal request/response core that all three hosting modes share, plus small mode-specific extension points for routing, secrets, and capabilities. Goal: avoid duped logic in SDKs and keep app semantics identical. Thoughts?

kai: love the idea. key risk is implicit assumptions sneaking into adapters (eg: "private always has KMS" baked into codepaths). keep the core dumb.

devon: Agree. For secrets we should use an opaque ref type in the core like `secret://<ref>` and let each adapter translate to real KMS/HSM APIs. That prevents any hosted/private leakage.

marta: exactly. core would only treat secrets as opaque strings with `secret_ref` schema. adapters register a handler for `secret://` URIs.

sam: telemetry note: we need a tiny tracing contract so metrics/dashboards work across modes. require adapters to set span tags: `hosting.mode`, `tenant_id_norm`, and `adapter.version`. If we don't normalize tenant id we'll never rollup.

lee: add a capability list on manifests so runtime can select compatible variants. something like: `capabilities: {streaming: true, kv_cache: false, quantization: "8bit"}`. then we can fallback cleanly.

marta: example manifest sketch (core + extensions):

```json
{
  "core": {
    "input": "text",
    "output": "tokens",
    "metadata": {"desired_latency_ms": 150}
  },
  "extensions": {
    "secrets": {"ref_scheme": "secret://"},
    "routing": {"policy": "latency_prefer"},
    "capabilities": {"streaming": true, "kv_cache": true}
  }
}
```

kai: migration path: add an `X-Adapter-Compat` header so older adapters can signal legacy behavior. values: `legacy-v1`, `core-v2`. control plane uses this to decide whether to enable shim transformations.

devon: rollout plan: gate on conformance tests. start by enabling core on Dedicated for a small tenant subset, then Private canary, then invite Hosted adapters to opt-in.

infra-ci: CI: created INF-7921 to add adapter conformance tests + runtime mismatch alerting. ETA 4 sprints. will include unit + integration harness.

sam: runtime mismatch behavior: if an app requests streaming but adapter reports no streaming, adapter should return a structured error with a stable code and hint, e.g.: {"code": 412, "message": "capability_missing", "hint": "fallback:polling"}. apps can surface friendly UX.

lee: agree. enumerate a small set of codes and `fallback_hint` strings so clients can programmatically react. also expose `adapter.reported_capabilities` in the diagnostics endpoint.

marta: perf/routing detail: core request can include `desired_latency_ms` and `cost_sensitivity` (low/medium/high) so adapters can pick kernel/quantization profiles dynamically. keeps UX consistent.

kai: security: adapters must not log plaintext key material. state this as a mandatory contract clause for any adapter onboarding. auditors will want it spelled out.

devon: also, private deployments may want to require offline HSM signing. adapters should expose `capabilities.hsm_signing` so control plane can check.

sam: next steps: I'll add telemetry fields to the tracing spec. Kai & Devon please draft the adapter shim spec (header semantics + transformation rules). Marta please author RFC with the manifest schema and the migration checklist. Ops-bot/infrastructure: track conformance work in INF-7921.

marta: will open the RFC in `architecture/rfcs` by EOD tomorrow. ping if you want to be reviewer. :rocket:
